**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A large white square plate, about 24–25 cm per side. Its area is about 600 cm² (a square, so I used side² instead of the circle formula).

**STEP 3 - Items:** Boiled cauliflower florets: one cluster at the top and several at the bottom. There is no visible oil or dressing.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The cauliflower covers about 12% of the plate, or roughly 72 cm². Most of the plate is empty, so this is the only item and the total coverage is about 12%.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** 72 cm² × 2.5 cm typical floret height = about 180 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** 180 ml × 0.6 g/ml (cut vegetables) = about 108 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Boiled cauliflower has about 23 kcal per 100 g, so 108 g × 0.23 = about 25 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About eight medium florets weighing roughly 100 g is plausible for what is visible. The energy is very low because there is no added fat.

**Total: about 108 g and 25 kcal.**
